---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused addition or change to bashlog
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or Use Case

Describe the concrete problem you are trying to solve.  Please include enough
context to distinguish a recurring need from a one-off preference.

## Proposed Behavior

Describe the public behavior you would like bashlog to provide.  Examples are
welcome, especially when they clarify API shape, output, failure behavior, or
interaction with existing logging/redaction semantics.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe caller-owned workarounds, wrappers, existing Bash facilities, or other
approaches you considered and why they are insufficient.

## Contract and Compatibility Impact

If known, note whether the proposal would change the public API, rendering,
redaction behavior, Bash 4.3 compatibility, pure-Bash runtime boundary, artifact
format, or release process.

## Additional Context

Add any other information that helps explain why the feature belongs in bashlog
rather than in a caller-owned wrapper or deployment environment.
